zh.title: 歡迎來到我的網站！
zh.body:
這是我第一次嘗試使用 vibe coding 製作的網站。
我會分享一點我的生活片段、一點我的內心想法在這邊。
總之，就是想到什麼我就加一點點在這裡，也是這些點點的碎片拼湊出完整的貽丞吧。
我想要把無聊的、精彩的時間，偷偷地保存在這裡。也很歡迎你透過這個窗口進入我的小天地。
(但也可能會懶得更新，因為如你所知道的，我還蠻懶惰的)

en.title: Welcome to my website!
en.body:
This is my first time trying to build a website with vibe coding.
I'll share bits of my life here, and bits of what's on my mind.
Basically, whatever comes to me, I add a little of it here — maybe these fragments, pieced together, add up to the whole of Yi-Cheng.
I want to quietly keep the boring moments and the exciting ones here alike. You're also very welcome to step through this window into my little world.
(Though I might also just get lazy about updating it — as you know, I'm quite lazy)
